item.title: Crofton
item.description: Crofton is a family-friendly community in central Anne Arundel County with excellent schools, parks, and proximity to Fort Meade and the NSA.

item.title: Fort Meade
item.description: Fort Meade is a U.S. Army installation in Anne Arundel County, home to the NSA and CIA, and a major employer for military and federal workers.
